transcript.message: Fair concern—900 sqft is compact for a family, so I wouldn’t want to call it spacious without knowing your needs. It’s a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout, planned with limited wasted corridor space, but whether it works really depends on who’ll be living there. How many people are in your family?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: That’s a fair concern for four people. The plan lists about 405 sq ft for the living, dining and kitchen area, and the project materials say all three bedrooms are designed to fit a queen-sized bed. But whether your furniture leaves comfortable walkways depends on its actual size—a show-unit walkthrough would help you judge that much better than the 900 sq ft figure alone. Are you more concerned about fitting the beds and wardrobes, or the sofa and dining set?
